{{Quote|The mighty Jabba and the Hutt families have decided to join you.|The droid, to Darth Maul|<ref name="Eminence (episode)">{{TCW|Eminence (episode)}}</ref>}}
Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] owned a '''vendor droid''' which translated his [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] to visitors to his [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]].

When the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] and [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] leader [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] came to the palace seeking an alliance with Jabba, the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] agreed and had his droid translate for him.
